truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. PLATFORM-00 and DAW-00 remain preserved incomplete.

DAW-00A through DAW-00E are implemented on stacked mergeable draft PRs #30-#34. DAW-00E exact head 3d0c5b0bba827ee002ef0c874e10654d699e7e91 is the CORE-02E baseline; hosted exact-head workflows remain UNOBSERVED where absent.

Global reselection moved out of DAW-00 because CORE-02 has one explicit mapped foundation gap, REQ-SCOPE-139 Success Memory with causality humility, and closing it has higher artist-facing dependency leverage than another DAW metadata layer.

CORE-02E is the only active increment. SuccessMemory is a pure-read synthesis over existing durable LearningMemory; it owns no persistence and does not mutate Learning, Evidence, Skill, Twin or Friction state.
Patterns group only by exact normalized domain, subject_ref and change_description. No fuzzy clustering or semantic similarity merges unrelated experiments.
KEEP is supporting evidence that the artist retained a change, not proof that the change caused an outcome or will generalize.
Humility states are NO_COMPLETED_EVIDENCE, SINGLE_OBSERVATION, SUCCESS_ONLY, MIXED, NO_KEEP_EVIDENCE and INCONCLUSIVE_ONLY. SUCCESS_ONLY explicitly warns that absence of counterexamples is not proof.
REVERT and REVISE remain counterexamples; INCONCLUSIVE remains explicit; unfinished episodes are visible as pending and do not increase completed sample size.

Success patterns preserve source Song IDs, episode IDs, observed consequence summaries, source kinds/source refs, condition episode counts, confounder/alternative-explanation episode counts and reported consequence/decision confidence summaries.
Conditions/confounders are counted by distinct episode so repeated observations inside one session do not impersonate independent samples.
Song-scoped reads remain isolated; artist-wide synthesis may merge the same exact pattern across Songs while retaining source Song provenance.

A pre-publication semantic harness covered 22 focused cases; a later semantic repair changed condition/confounder counting to distinct episodes and retained explicit consequence source references. Repository Headquarters regressions are authored; full exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
No recommendation ranking, causal inference, ML training, automatic taste doctrine, DAW work, platform packaging, UI or provider analytics is included in CORE-02E.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
